options.name: Port
options.description: TCP port the MCP server listens on (default 8017; retries the next 9 ports if busy)

options.name: Listen on LAN
options.description: Accept connections from other machines on your network. Off = this PC only (localhost).

options.name: Discovery mode
options.description: Hide archetype ability previews from the AI so it discovers the game blind. Off = previews shown (default).
